title: The Beach Clean-Up
scene: Student volunteers collecting litter along a Singapore beach at low tide, with plastic bottles and abandoned rubbish washed up among the sand and driftwood.
questions: Describe what is happening in this picture.
How do you think the volunteers feel as they fill the bags?
Tell me about a time you did something to help the environment.
Cleaning up is useful, but the rubbish keeps coming back. What else should be done?
Whose responsibility is it to keep our beaches clean? Why?
